return7.tapebin: a real UTAPEBIN v1 package of `int main(void){return 7;}`, written by the 79fb84e6 product (`-S --tapebin -o return7.tapebin m.c`, sha256 of the product out/unisacc.com.79fb84e6: 79fb84e65a10b55ce40be5f68746748acbd38f441944046c0a5dfa5718bc0c32). Frozen because the 0.0.43 product decodes UTAPEBIN but has no encoder (C44-TAPEBIN-01); tools/link-malformed-input.cx derives its damaged tapebins from it.
